_note: Frozen grandfather list for gate-scoping-report.md (2026-08-01 follow-up). Filenames listed here are PRE-EXISTING debt as of the date this file was created — check-brief.mjs/check-h9.mjs report them as standing debt but never block a commit on them. This list is NOT auto-updated: a file added here later must be a deliberate owner decision (a new noncompliant file must never be silently grandfathered — that would recreate the exact flaw this fix closes). A file already on the list that becomes compliant is harmless to leave here (it just never fires); removing it is optional cleanup, not required.

_owner_additions.decision: owner-approved (option א): grandfather these five AND build the root-cause fix in the same breath
_owner_additions.why: These five were machine-sliced out of plan text and carry none of the six §13 fields. They are already-executed historical artefacts; editing them now to add the markers would fabricate evidence of a contract that was not actually followed, so they are recorded as debt rather than retouched. Adding to this list without fixing the cause is how a waiver list rots — so the same decision required scripts/make-brief.mjs, which builds a template-shaped brief from a plan and REFUSES to emit one when the two judgement fields (spec lines, primary tool) are missing or placeholders. A generator that emitted "TODO" would satisfy the marker scan and defeat the gate it serves.
_owner_additions.root_cause_fix: scripts/make-brief.mjs + scripts/tests/test-make-brief.mjs (10/10, includes check-brief accepting the generator output)
